identity.name: Xaero Minimap × EMF Entity Icon Compatibility

goals: Retain accepted Canary 9 exactly as the user-reported external PASS baseline while reopening the project for the reported current resource-pack regression.
Repair only the C10 allowlisted Minecraft entities and five exact villager professions through a fail-closed targeted EMF composition policy and a separate Xaero-raster presentation policy.
Keep every unlisted entity and villager profession on the exact C9 path; retain historical runtime evidence without transferring it to Canary 10.
scope: Reuse the existing C9 failed-upstream EMF-to-Xaero seam and canonical-frame adapter without modifying its generic selector; C10 enters only for exact fox, goat, frog, bogged, witch, and the five declared minecraft:villager professions.

Use only detached icon-only C10 compositions: fox/goat body/head2, frog body/body2 plus head2, bogged headwear, witch body/head2 plus body/hat, and a profession-gated villager nose/frog_eyes/matching-hat plan. Fail closed to C9 if a named structure is absent or untraced.
Apply 1.50 Xaero raster request scaling only to ghast and happy_ghast and 0.75 only to bee and rabbit; preserve C9 cache/reload ownership and all Naturalist/Ribbits companion boundaries.

exclusions: Broad selector changes, wildcard entity/profession matching, whole-body icons, live model mutation, world-model scaling, and unsupported runtime claims.
Changes to Naturalist, Ribbits, upstream Xaero, Fresh Animations, EMF, ETF or other projects.
Static mob icons, copied upstream assets or classes, replacement entity rendering, networking, server behavior, and redistribution of Xaero's All Rights Reserved content.
The retired Diagnostic2 source workspace, unretained generated outputs, legacy status narratives, Test Instance Manager state, deployment ledgers, snapshots, and historical administrative matrices.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, either Test Slot, accepted-baseline mutation, map-data changes, and access to the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
Dedicated-server, exhaustive all-mob, per-check Canary 3, or other runtime validation not present in the frozen evidence.
